method: Two sequential title loads in one real GPU Engine: baseline then revised; warm:none, 1440x900. Both baseline audio modules are intercepted at their original routes.

loads.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (0x00002C02) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (0x00002C02) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

limitations: Only one load per version; first uses a newly launched browser, second may benefit from browser/OS warm caches. Engine includes opening-screen dismissal and its fixed settling waits. This is a short regression check, not a cold/warm benchmark.
